title: Mars exploration, May 22, 1984
summary: Title page of the session record: "Mars Exploration, May 22, 1984".

title: Method of site acquisition
summary: The target was set by a sealed envelope plus geographic coordinates. The subject held the envelope, unopened until after the interview; inside, a 3x5 card read "The planet Mars. Time of interest approximately 1 million years B.C." Coordinates chosen by the requesting parties were read aloud during the session.

title: Transcript, May 22, 1984
summary: Monitor and subject exchange from 10:09 AM. Moved through a series of coordinates, the subject describes a pyramid, megalithic structures, a carved canyon, an obelisk, a huge basin, channels like aqueducts and pyramids used as storm shelters, then very tall, thin, dying ancient people waiting for a party that left to find a new home.

nodes.title: Pyramid at 40.89 N, 9.55 W and the time before the geologic event
nodes.summary: At 40.89 N, 9.55 W the subject sees a very high, yellowish, okra-colored pyramid form in a large depressed area, then dust storms after a major geologic problem. Before it, he sees large smooth megalithic surfaces and walls, and the shadows of very tall, thin, very large people in strange clothing.

nodes.title: Carved canyon at 46.45 N, 353.22 E
nodes.summary: Moved to 46.45 N, 353.22 E in the same time period, the subject is deep in a canyon whose steep wall has been carved into huge structures of smooth stone. Inside they are like a rabbit warren of very large rooms with high ceilings and wide walls. The monitor notes real time plus 22 minutes.

nodes.title: Obelisk, basin and white squares
nodes.summary: At 45.86 N, 354.1 E the subject sees the end of a very large road with a huge obelisk like the Washington Monument. At 35.26 N, 213.24 E he is in a huge circular basin ringed by tall, ragged mountains. At 34.6 N, 213.09 E he sees a cluster of squares almost flush with the ground, white or reflecting light.

nodes.title: Channels at 34.57 N, 212.22 E and 15 N, 198 E
nodes.summary: The subject notes the sun looks strange, then at 34.57 N, 212.22 E sees a radiating pattern of deep intersecting roads cut into valleys. The monitor says he is electrically nulled out and asks him to refocus. At 15 N, 198 E he sees round-bottomed carved channels like aqueducts and pointed tops on a misty, distant horizon.

nodes.title: Pyramids at 80 S, 64 E used as storm shelters
nodes.summary: At 80 S, 64 E the subject sees huge pyramids with insides and outsides. The monitor decides to let him follow what interests him instead of the listed targets. The pyramids are shelters from storms; inside, bare functional chambers are used for sleeping or hibernating through savage storms. Plus 37 minutes real time.

nodes.title: The tall people who sleep through the storms
nodes.summary: The sleepers are very tall, thin people in fitted, silk-like clothing. They are ancient and dying, philosophical but unable to survive, waiting for a party that left to find a new home as their environment failed. The subject links this to a globe passing through a comet's tail. The monitor notes a voltage reversal at plus 40 minutes.

nodes.title: The journey of those who left, and end of interview
nodes.summary: The person questioned does not know who the subject is and says they must wait. Those who left went in something like a large boat with rounded walls of shiny metal, to a volatile place of volcanoes, gas pockets, strange plants and dense vegetation. The monitor brings the subject back to 22 May 1984 and the interview ends.
